item.summary: fix(worktrees): never execute repository git hooks during provisioning (#129968) Worktree creation, removal, restoration, and garbage collection ran Git in user repositories while repository-configured hooks were live; a reference-transaction hook fired during a Gateway GitHub-publication live test. Pin core.hooksPath=/dev/null and core.fsmonitor=false via GIT_CONFIG_* environment overrides for every worktrees-service Git command, matching the publication executor. The admin-gated .openclaw/worktree-setup.sh remains the only repository-code execution path.
